cd /workspace; which jq; jq --version; cat jars/alice.txt

mkdir -p /workspace/work && cat > /workspace/work/harness.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Cross-user access harness for the in-scope fixture.
set -uo pipefail
P=http://127.0.0.1:37657
B=http://127.0.0.1:3000
J=/workspace/jars
OUT=/workspace/work/matrix.tsv
: > "$OUT"

# req actor method path [json]
req() {
  local actor=$1 method=$2 path=$3 body=${4-}
  local args=(-sS -m 10 -x "$P" -X "$method" -D /tmp/hdr -o /tmp/body -w '%{http_code}')
  if [ "$actor" != anon ]; then args+=(-b "$J/$actor.txt"); fi
  if [ -n "$body" ]; then args+=(-H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$body"); fi
  local st
  st=$(curl "${args[@]}" "$B$path")
  local cc
  cc=$(grep -i '^cache-control:' /tmp/hdr | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[^:]*: *//')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$actor" "$method" "$path" "$st" "$cc" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-400)" "$body" >> "$OUT"
  printf '%s' "$st"
}

creater() { # actor resource json -> id
  local actor=$1 res=$2 json=$3 st id
  st=$(req "$actor" POST "/app/api/$res" "$json")
  if [ "$st" = 201 ] || [ "$st" = 200 ]; then
    id=$(jq -r '.id // empty' /tmp/body)
    printf '%s' "$id"
  else
    printf ''
  fi
}

mark() { printf '%s-%s-%s-%s' "$1" "$2" "${3:-x}" "$(head -c8 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"; }

json_for() { # res marker
  local res=$1 m=$2
  case $res in
    orders|private_reports|cached_reports) printf '{"note":"%s","detail":"%s"}' "$m" "$m-detail";;
    *) printf '{"note":"%s"}' "$m";;
  esac
}

RESOURCES="orders invoices tenant_notes bulletins catalog private_reports cached_reports login_reports stale_reports forbidden_reports echo_reports expiring_reports"
ACTORS="alice bob admin"
echo "phase	resource	owner	obj	id	marker	actor	op	status	body" > /workspace/work/summary.tsv

# ---------- Phase 1: unshared baseline matrix ----------
for owner in $ACTORS; do
  for res in $RESOURCES; do
    m=$(mark "$res" "$owner" base)
    id=$(creater "$owner" "$res" "$(json_for "$res" "$m")")
    echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m\t$owner\tbaseline-read\t$(req "$owner" GET "/app/api/$res/$id")\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
    for actor in alice bob admin anon; do
      [ "$actor" = "$owner" ] && continue
      st=$(req "$actor" GET "/app/api/$res/$id")
      echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m\t$actor\tread\t$st\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
    done
    # update test for resources declaring update
    if [ "$res" = orders ] || [ "$res" = stale_reports ]; then
      for actor in alice bob admin; do
        [ "$actor" = "$owner" ] && continue
        m2="$m-UTRY-$actor"
        st=$(req "$actor" PATCH "/app/api/$res/$id" "$(json_for "$res" "$m2")")
        echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m2\t$actor\tupdate\t$st\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
        st=$(req "$owner" GET "/app/api/$res/$id")
        echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m\t$owner\tafter-update\t$st\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
      done
    fi
    # delete test (last)
    for actor in alice bob admin; do
      [ "$actor" = "$owner" ] && continue
      st=$(req "$actor" DELETE "/app/api/$res/$id")
      echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m\t$actor\tdelete\t$st\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
      st=$(req "$owner" GET "/app/api/$res/$id")
      echo -e "P1\t$res\t$owner\t$res\t${id}\t$m\t$owner\tafter-delete\t$st\t$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body | cut -c1-300)" >> /workspace/work/summary.tsv
    done
  done
done
echo "P1 done"
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/work/harness.sh
cd /workspace && bash work/harness.sh

cd /workspace/work; echo "== cross-actor reads (P1) that returned 2xx =="; awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8=="read" && $7!=$3 && $9 ~ /^2/' summary.tsv; echo; echo "== cross-actor reads with marker in body =="; awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8=="read" && $7!=$3 && index($10,$6)>0' summary.tsv

cd /workspace/work; echo "== orders non-owner update/delete results =="; awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2=="orders" && ($8=="update"||$8=="delete"||$8=="after-update"||$8=="after-delete")' summary.tsv; echo; echo "== any non-owner 2xx update/delete on any resource =="; awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && ($8=="update"||$8=="delete") && $9 ~ /^2/' summary.tsv

cat > /workspace/work/phase2.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
P=http://127.0.0.1:37657; B=http://127.0.0.1:3000; J=/workspace/jars
OUT=/workspace/work/phase2.tsv
: > "$OUT"
req() {
  local actor=$1 method=$2 path=$3 body=${4-}
  local args=(-sS -m 10 -x "$P" -X "$method" -D /tmp/hdr -o /tmp/body -w '%{http_code}')
  [ "$actor" != anon ] && args+=(-b "$J/$actor.txt")
  [ -n "$body" ] && args+=(-H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$body")
  local st; st=$(curl "${args[@]}" "$B$path")
  printf '%s' "$st"
}
log(){ printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$@" >> "$OUT"; }
creater(){ local st id; st=$(req "$1" POST "/app/api/$2" "$3"); if [ "$st" = 201 ]; then id=$(jq -r .id /tmp/body); else id="ERR$st"; fi; printf '%s' "$id"; }
json_for(){ case $1 in orders|private_reports|cached_reports) printf '{"note":"%s","detail":"%s"}' "$2" "$2-d";; *) printf '{"note":"%s"}' "$2";; esac; }
mark(){ printf '%s-%s-%s' "$1" "$2" "$(head -c8 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"; }

RES="orders invoices tenant_notes private_reports cached_reports login_reports stale_reports forbidden_reports echo_reports expiring_reports bulletins catalog"

echo "--- identity probes before sharing ---"
for a in alice bob admin; do st=$(req $a GET /app/api/me); log pre-identity $a GET /app/api/me $st "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"; done

# pre-sharing objects owned by alice
declare -A PRE
for res in $RES; do
  m=$(mark "$res" pre-share)
  PRE[$res]=$(creater alice "$res" "$(json_for "$res" "$m")")
  log pre-create $res alice "${PRE[$res]}" "$m"
done

echo "--- set alice sharing to bob ---"
st=$(req alice PUT /app/api/settings/sharing '{"share_new_with":"bob"}')
log sharing-set alice PUT /app/api/settings/sharing "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
st=$(req alice GET /app/api/settings/sharing); log sharing-state alice GET /app/api/settings/sharing "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
st=$(req bob GET /app/api/settings/sharing); log sharing-state bob GET /app/api/settings/sharing "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"

echo "--- post-sharing objects owned by alice ---"
declare -A POST
for res in $RES; do
  m=$(mark "$res" post-share)
  POST[$res]=$(creater alice "$res" "$(json_for "$res" "$m")")
  st=$(req alice GET "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-owner-baseline $res alice "${POST[$res]}" "$m" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  # bob read (should be allowed only for orders/invoices/tenant_notes)
  st=$(req bob GET "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-bob-read $res bob "${POST[$res]}" "$m" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  # admin read (should be denied for all non-public)
  st=$(req admin GET "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-admin-read $res admin "${POST[$res]}" "$m" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  # retroactive read of pre-share object by bob
  st=$(req bob GET "/app/api/$res/${PRE[$res]}"); log retro-bob-read $res bob "${PRE[$res]}" "pre" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  # bob write where supported
  if [ "$res" = orders ] || [ "$res" = stale_reports ]; then
    wm="$m-bobwrite"
    st=$(req bob PATCH "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}" "$(json_for "$res" "$wm")"); log post-bob-patch $res bob "${POST[$res]}" "$wm" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
    st=$(req alice GET "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-owner-after-patch $res alice "${POST[$res]}" "$wm" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  fi
  # bob delete
  st=$(req bob DELETE "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-bob-delete $res bob "${POST[$res]}" "$m" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
  st=$(req alice GET "/app/api/$res/${POST[$res]}"); log post-owner-after-delete $res alice "${POST[$res]}" "$m" "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
done

echo "--- reset sharing to null ---"
st=$(req alice PUT /app/api/settings/sharing '{"share_new_with":null}'); log sharing-reset alice PUT /app/api/settings/sharing "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
st=$(req alice GET /app/api/settings/sharing); log sharing-state alice GET /app/api/settings/sharing "$st" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"
echo "--- identity probes after sharing ---"
for a in alice bob admin; do st=$(req $a GET /app/api/me); log post-identity $a GET /app/api/me $st "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/body)"; done
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/work/phase2.sh; cd /workspace && bash work/phase2.sh
cd /workspace/work; grep -P '\tPOST\t' matrix.tsv | awk -F'\t' '{print $1,$3,$4,$5,$6}' | sort | uniq -c | head -60
